description: This file defines the DeprecationCollector class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for collecting deprecation notices from Twig templates within a directory or provided iterator.

classes.name: Twig\Util\DeprecationCollector
classes.description: Final class responsible for collecting deprecation notices from Twig templates in specified directories or iterators.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DeprecationCollector with a Twig environment instance.

methods.name: collectDir
methods.description: Collects deprecation notices from templates in the specified directory, filtered by extension.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: Processes an iterator of templates to gather deprecation messages, optionally handling errors.
